title: Azami Chapter 1 v2 reproducibility input package
description: SHA-locked binary inputs for independent reproduction of the frozen Azami Chapter 1 v2 image-phenomics analysis. The accompanying public GitHub repository contains the analysis code, contracts, frozen outputs, validation reports, and third-party reproduction runbook.
notes: Publish the prepared reproduction bundle only after verifying its SHA-256. After publication, independently re-download without author credentials and update reproducibility/public_release_manifest.json with the DOI and stable URL.
